We're on it. Quick findings from initial SRE checks: AZ3 is reporting a disproportionate number of transient kernel-level OOMs on model-worker nodes and the autoscaler is struggling to reconcile due to bursty prefix patterns. There is healthy spare capacity in US-AM-Central and US-West2.

Plan I can execute in ~25 minutes:
- Stage routing rule in the control plane to shift 65% of sessions to US-AM-Central; set session-balanced diversion so existing connections drain gracefully.
- In parallel, enable temporary priority pin + 2x burst capacity on the target pool.
- Monitor KV cache miss amplification; if we see >15% latency regression on target, pause and revert.

Risk: cold KV cache will increase token-cost and latency for first 5–10 minutes; we should communicate that to the customer. I'll attach the runbook and start the routing stage once Marcus signs off.

Rishi
Principal SRE — Serving Runtime
